name: ErGear Electric Standing Desk, 48 x 24 in Sit-Stand Desk with Memory Presets (Black)
description:
- Excellent stability: a sturdy solid-steel frame with aerospace-grade lifting column connectors (still stable and safe after 100,000 test cycles) gives you a firm base to work on, even at maximum height.
- Smooth height adjustment: set the desk anywhere from 28.35 to 46.46 inches. Save your three favorite heights and switch between them smoothly.
- Upgraded motor: strong lifting performance and reliable long-term operation (tested 50,000 times and still going strong).
- Safe, low-VOC materials: formaldehyde and other VOC emissions are drastically reduced, meeting US federal and state safe-air standards.
- Simplified assembly: fewer steps and less heavy lifting than typical electric standing desks.
- Note: cable-management features include desk grommet holes or cable slots.

name: DUMOS 32 Inch Small Computer Desk with X-Brace Steel Frame
description:
- X-shaped reinforcement: unlike flimsy desks, the DUMOS computer desk uses a smart X-brace design that stops annoying wobble while you type and keeps the desk perfectly level for years.
- Premium materials: a scratch- and water-resistant surface that shrugs off coffee spills, backed by a sturdy steel frame built for your busiest workdays.
- Thick square-tube legs: heavy-duty square steel legs hold up to 265 lbs, so it works for projects, storage or as a study and writing desk.
- Multiple options: choose from 6 practical sizes and 3 colors to match your room layout and style.
- Easy installation: sets up in minutes with all tools and parts included and clear, simple instructions.

name: FEZIBO Electric Standing Desk, 48 x 24 in Height Adjustable Desk (Maple)
description:
- Electric lifting system: a reliable motor adjusts the height from 27.3 to 45.5 inches and runs quietly, under 50 dB.
- Easy sit-stand transitions: switching between sitting and standing reduces the risks of sitting for long periods, such as leg swelling and back strain, and encourages better circulation and spine health.
- Spacious 48 x 24 in top: room for dual monitors, a printer and other office essentials. The wooden desktop is FSC-certified.
- Height memory and anti-collision: 3 programmable memory buttons. If the desk hits an obstacle while rising, it moves back 0.8 inches to prevent damage or injury.
- Convenient installation: a detailed installation video is available for reference (reset: hold the DOWN button for 5 seconds).

name: SHW Mission Home Office Computer Desk, 40 Inch, Black
description:
- Compact and functional: the 40-inch-wide desk is a space-saving fit for home offices, bedrooms or small work areas, with room for a laptop, monitor and essentials.
- Durable build: a powder-coated steel frame and engineered-wood top provide stability for everyday use.
- Modern look: a mission-style design that complements many home decor styles.
- Easy assembly: step-by-step instructions and all hardware included, no extra tools needed.
- 5-year limited warranty for long-term reliability.
- Product dimensions: 19" D x 40" W x 28" H.

name: Huuger 55 Inch Computer Desk for Home Office and Gaming with Metal Frame
description:
- Simple desk: a clean, spacious workspace in rustic brown measuring 54 x 19.7 x 29.5 inches, with room for your computer, lamp and essentials plus a cup of coffee.
- Versatile: works as a large office desk, bedroom desk, gaming setup or kids' room desk.
- Reinforced structure: durable particleboard and thick steel tubes, with reinforcement struts under the top for extra stability.
- Styles and colors: 5 modern finishes (gray, black, rustic brown, rustic brown and black, and white) in multiple sizes.
- Easy assembly: simple structure, visual instructions and tools included; done in under 40 minutes.

name: Huuger Electric Standing Desk with Power Outlets and USB-C, 47 x 24 in
description:
- Built-in outlets and cable management: a charging station with 4 AC outlets, 1 USB and 1 USB-C powers up to 6 devices at once, while integrated cable management keeps cords tidy.
- Height adjustable with digital display: a 28.7 to 46.5 inch range with 4 memory presets for your sitting and standing positions, shown on an LED display.
- Ultra-quiet: an upgraded motor runs below 35 dB, quiet enough for shared spaces, video calls or early mornings.
- Rock-solid at full height: a reinforced 2.6-inch steel frame, T-shaped support bar and adjustable feet; tested over 60,000 lift cycles and holds up to 220 lbs, even with dual monitors.
- Safety and easy setup: anti-collision technology reverses automatically when it detects an obstacle, and clear instructions get it set up in about 30 minutes.

name: Cubiker Electric Standing Desk with Drawers and Monitor Shelf, 48 x 24 in (Maple)
description:
- Keypad controller: 4 buttons to preset heights from 27 to 46 inches, moving at 1 inch per second with low noise under 50 dB.
- Spacious monitor stand: the top shelf with drawers keeps the desk tidy and raises your screens to eye level to ease neck and back strain.
- Locking casters: 360-degree swivel wheels make the desk mobile and protect your floor from scratches.
- 4 drawers: plenty of storage for home-office essentials (each removable drawer is 3.23 in H x 12.4 in W x 8.46 in D).
- Reliable standing desk: an industrial-grade steel frame and solid desktop support up to 176 lbs.

name: VASAGLE Computer Desk, Gaming Desk with Steel Frame, 47.2 x 19.7 in
description:
- Versatile workspace: a 47.2 x 19.7 inch top covers everyday needs for work, study or gaming.
- Simple and stylish: a minimalist design with clean lines that fits into many interiors, from study to bedroom to living room.
- Stable and durable: a sturdy top and premium steel frame support up to 110 lbs.
- Quick setup: simple instructions and clearly labeled parts make assembly easy.
- No wobble: adjustable feet keep the desk level on slightly uneven floors and protect the floor from scratches.

name: AODK L-Shaped Gaming Desk with LED Lights and Power Outlets
description:
- Reversible L-shaped desk: comes with storage shelves, power outlets, an LED light strip, CPU stand, headphone hook and storage bag. The top hutch mounts on the left or right, making it ideal for corners, home offices, gaming and study.
- Outlets and charging ports: 3 AC outlets and 2 USB charging ports keep your phone, gaming gear and Bluetooth devices powered while you work or play.
- Colorful LED lights: 10 static colors, 8 brightness levels, 10 dynamic modes and a memory function to set the right ambience and reduce eye strain.
- Plenty of storage: 18.9 in D x 53 in W x 29.8 in H, with 2 shelves, a CPU stand, headphone hook and storage bag. The 2-tier top shelf can be used as a display shelf or monitor stand.
- Easy assembly and support: detailed instructions and clearly labeled parts; if anything arrives damaged or missing, customer service responds within 24 hours.

name: Claiks Electric Standing Desk, 48 x 24 in Height Adjustable Desk
description:
- Ergonomic home office desk: the result of years of iteration, built to support up to 176 lbs.
- Electric height adjustment: three preset buttons to save heights from 28.3" to 46.5".
- Excellent stability: an industrial-grade steel frame keeps the desk steady.
- Ergonomic workspace: a generous 48 x 24 inch splice top with rounded edges and arched round legs.
- Easy assembly: a detailed manual, precise installation video, pre-drilled screw holes and an included wrench.
